incident_reports.forced_entry_method: Pry tool marks on rear ground-floor sliding window
incident_reports.narrative: Patrol units responded to a silent burglar alarm at a commercial premises. Officers observed two individuals exiting through the rear alleyway carrying a dark duffel bag. Suspect 1 (identified as OID#4418) was detained at the corner; Suspect 2 (identified as OID#8864) was apprehended attempting to enter a nearby getaway sedan. Stolen items recovered on scene matched inventory reported by property owner.
